finding.title: Upstream refreshed: openapi.json
finding.body:
`sources refresh` replaced the vendor's pinned copy .factory/sources/openapi.upstream.json (upstream_sha256 fd9b7f18853576bfb6a7f8c79966484d244a926b26066a3f9a5cc8019f94ea18) with openapi.v2.json (upstream_sha256 51190dafa9d26ab2cc3b4d20944694c05505e37f4828284cd45bbe8d0adb4c1f; openapi 3.0.3). Of 1 recorded patch, 1 re-applied and kept on the entry, 0 obsolete (the vendor's document now says what the patch produced; dropped), 0 in conflict (the vendor changed the target; dropped and not applied — re-apply the intent by hand and codify it). The working copy was rewritten from the new upstream plus the re-applied patches; their `verified` evidence was recorded against the previous baseline.
Patches:
- reapplied: remove /components/schemas/Payment/discriminator/mapping (was {"card":"#/components/schemas/CardPayment","bank":"#/components/schemas/BankPayment"}) — `was` still matches [The inventory reader drops discriminator.mapping, which left Order.payment unresolved in source coverage; each member's type enum (CardPayment card, BankPayment bank) already states the same mapping, so the discriminator keeps propertyName only.]

Reason: Lumen Books published API 2.0.0 (demo/graphos/openapi.v2.json)
